reason: Joining is free and the money stays held until the job is done, which covers the unpaid-jobs problem that keeps me up at night. I would try it on a couple of jobs to see whether the requests are real, but I would not move my Instagram and WhatsApp work onto it.
objection: Another channel means another inbox to watch and another place where customers can change their mind, and I don't know yet whether the requests that come through are worth the time it takes to quote on them.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real paid requests from customers in my own area, in my service category, arriving at a rate that beats the time I spend on quotes.
